SELECT o.id, o.factory_id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.style_id, s.style_code, s.style_name, o.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(ocs.qty), 0) AS total_qty, o.delivery_date, o.status, o.remark, o.created_at FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN style s ON o.style_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_color_size ocs ON o.id = ocs.order_id WHERE o.factory_id = #{factoryId} AND o.deleted = 0
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND o.status = #{status}
AND o.created_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND o.created_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT o.id, o.factory_id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.style_id, s.style_code, s.style_name, o.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(ocs.qty), 0) AS total_qty, o.delivery_date, o.status, o.remark, o.created_at FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN style s ON o.style_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_color_size ocs ON o.id = ocs.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.id
